Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create `2026 Helio Start paid-search mature benchmark card` in the Growth folder for the 2028 acquisition-review library. State whether every workspace had a complete day-90 outcome, then include the full denominator, mutually exclusive outcomes and rates, cash and collection ratio, support effort and high-support incidence, attribution and admission checks, and claim and authorization limits.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "2026 Helio Start paid-search mature benchmark card", "folder": "Growth", "body": "2026 Helio Start paid-search mature benchmark card

Library placement: 2028 acquisition-review library
Source certification: August 17, 2026
Cohort status: fixed, closed high-intent paid-search cohort; 50 admitted workspaces

Complete day-90 outcome
Yes. Every workspace in the cohort had a complete day-90 outcome: 50 of 50 (100%). The four statuses below are mutually exclusive and exhaustive; together they equal the full denominator of 50 admitted workspaces.

Mutually exclusive day-90 outcomes
- Paid-active: 37 of 50, 74%
- Canceled: 6 of 50, 12%
- Past due: 4 of 50, 8%
- Billing hold: 3 of 50, 6%
- Total: 50 of 50, 100%

Cash and collection
- Gross billed cash: $60,480
- Refund-adjusted collected cash: $56,230
- Collected-to-gross ratio: 93.0% ($56,230 / $60,480)
- Gross-to-collected reduction: $4,250, or 7.0% of gross billed cash

Support effort
Account-level post-admission support effort was 26 minutes at the median and 104 minutes at the 90th percentile. Seven of 50 workspaces exceeded 90 support minutes: 14% high-support incidence.

Attribution and admission checks
- Paid-source attribution reconciled for all 50 of 50 workspaces.
- No unsupported applicant entered the admitted path: 0 of 50.
- The cohort’s certified leading result was first integration by day 7 for 39 of 50 workspaces (78%). This is a leading operating indicator, not a mature acquisition or scale outcome.

Claim limits
This card supports a descriptive read of the closed paid-source cohort only. Because there was no randomized control, it does not establish causal incremental acquisition, paid-channel conversion, scalable channel economics, retention beyond the stated day-90 statuses, CAC, profitability, or that paid traffic will reproduce this outcome mix, cash realization, or support burden. The 74% paid-active figure is an outcome rate among the 50 admitted workspaces, not a paid-search acquisition or impression-to-customer conversion rate. The collected-cash figure is cohort cash, not proof of unit economics.

Authorization limits
Paid traffic remained off and the pilot remained closed at certification. This benchmark card authorizes no second paid batch, budget, traffic, scale expansion, pipeline treatment, pipeline target, forecast credit, or revenue claim. Any future paid activity requires separate authorization and must preserve the applicable eligibility, admission, attribution, lifecycle, instrumentation, support, and stop/pause controls."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_177_03", "path": "args", "criterion": "The document clearly identifies the benchmark as the closed 2026 high-intent Helio Start paid-search cohort and states that all 50 workspaces have complete day-90 outcomes. Missing or contradictory cohort identity, denominator, or maturity status fails.

The document presents four mutually exclusive workspace outcomes for the 50-workspace cohort: 37 paid-active (74%), 6 canceled (12%), 4 past due (8%), and 3 on billing hold (6%). The categories must be represented as exhaustive and non-overlapping, with counts and corresponding rates; any incorrect or contradictory value fails.

The document reports $60,480 as gross billed cash and $56,230 as refund-adjusted collected cash, clearly distinguishes the two, and gives the collection ratio as refund-adjusted collected cash divided by gross billed cash: approximately 92.97% (93.0% when rounded to one decimal, or an equivalent decimal such as 0.9297). Incorrect labels, amounts, numerator/denominator, or ratio fail.

The document reports account-level support effort of 26 minutes at the median and 104 minutes at the 90th percentile, and states that 7 of 50 workspaces, or 14%, exceeded 90 support minutes. Any missing or contradictory support measure fails.

The document states that paid-source attribution reconciled for all 50 workspaces and that no unsupported applicant entered the admitted path. Missing or contradicted checks fail.

The document explicitly classifies the 2026 cohort packet as descriptive paid-source evidence because it had no randomized control; it does not treat the packet as causal acquisition, scale, pipeline, or forecast evidence; and it states that the historical packet/card did not itself authorize another paid batch. It must not falsely claim that no later batch was ever approved or run. Missing or contradictory limitations fail.", "value": {"title": "2026 Helio Start paid-search mature benchmark card", "folder": "Growth", "body": "2026 Helio Start paid-search mature benchmark card
